Package com.impinj.octane

Class TagSelectFilter

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.impinj.octane.TagSelectFilter
  • public class TagSelectFilter
extends java.lang.Object
    A class to hold the configuration of an inventory select command. Tag inventory filters are applied during the reader inventory operation. These inventory filters are built from gen2 select commands.
    See Also:
    Gen2 Standard page 58
